shortBulletSummary: A US military strike on Iran's Qeshm Island caused a crypto selloff, with Bitcoin dipping below $100K and triggering $700M in liquidations.
US inflation cooled to 3.5% in June, increasing expectations for steady Fed rates and supporting risk assets.
Bitcoin recovered above $102,000 after its dip, while the overall Crypto Fear and Greed Index is currently Neutral at 52.
T. Rowe Price launched an active spot crypto ETF, including BTC, ETH, and XRP as top holdings.
US regulators missed the one-year deadline for finalizing stablecoin rules under the GENIUS Act.
